generation.prompt: an acoustic indie folk song with a single clear female lead vocal, sparse acoustic guitar and light percussion, featuring a distinct eight-second instrumental break in the middle with no singing
generation.route: worker/scripts/music_smoke.py -> LtxAdapter music path -> acestep provider at 127.0.0.1:8001
generation.note: The adapter plans its own section structure from genre and reported 'intro -> verse -> chorus -> verse -> outro'. The supplied lyrics still reached the model (verified: 24 matches for distinctive lyric words in the service log).

format_deviation.reason: ACE-Step's own API encodes to MP3 before returning; there is no WAV or FLAC anywhere in the provider's serving path and no env var exposes the AudioSaver format. Our adapter then re-encodes to 192 kbps. MP3 is therefore what production produces and what both LTX A2V and H3 fully_copy will actually receive, so a WAV here would be less representative, not more.
format_deviation.evidence: acestep/audio_utils.py AudioSaver supports flac/wav/mp3 and defaults to flac, but the API server path calls _save_mp3 at 128k; log line '[AudioSaver] Saved audio to ... (mp3, 48000Hz, 128k)'.
format_deviation.quality_impact: 128 kbps source re-encoded to 192 kbps. Adequate for vocal-onset timing and envelope work; not a mastering-grade reference.

why_these_lyrics.bilabials: 'My mama made a promise' / 'Pockets empty, bottle broken' - m, b, p close the lips visibly and are the single most discriminating cue for lip-sync scoring.
why_these_lyrics.plosive_staccato: 'Black cab, back street, quick step, don't stop' / 'Tick tock, pick the lock' - sharp consonant onsets give precise timing anchors for measuring lag.
why_these_lyrics.sustained_open_vowels: 'Oh, I am alive' / 'survive' / 'mine' - held open vowels test whether the mouth holds a shape rather than flapping.
why_these_lyrics.labiodentals: 'Far from the farm where my father stayed' / 'Fever, feather, seven, silver' - f and v put lip to teeth, a distinct visual shape from both bilabials and vowels.
why_these_lyrics.structure: An instrumental break between the two halves is the test for presence-blindness: does the model keep mouthing when nobody is singing? That is a failure mode we have already recorded elsewhere in the chain.

measured.method: ffmpeg showspectrumpic (log/log) read visually, plus per-second RMS in a 300-3400 Hz band
measured.vocals_evidence: Gliding formant bands at roughly 400-950 Hz with visible pitch movement and vibrato - a sung voice, not guitar harmonics.
measured.break_evidence: Sharp vertical discontinuity across the full spectrum at ~53-55 s, with visibly thinner upper-mid harmonic density from ~55 s to ~72 s.

what: Exact vocal onset and offset timestamps.
Whether the 53-55 s break is genuinely vocal-free for 2 s or more, which is what the asset manifest requires.
NOT_YET_VERIFIED.why: A spectrogram cannot separate voice from guitar with certainty, and both occupy the same band. Reading it visually establishes that vocals exist and that a structural break exists; it does not establish per-frame vocal activity.
NOT_YET_VERIFIED.how_to_settle: Run a vocal separator (e.g. demucs) over the track and take per-frame vocal RMS, or have a person listen once and note the timestamps. Until then, do not treat these numbers as lip-sync ground truth.
